title: Yellow Molten Spanish Shrimp Gambas Al Ajillo
description: A funky and indulgent Spanish dish featuring shrimp in a miso and toor dal infused sauce, this recipe is high in protein and perfect for a dinner party. It has a molten and creamy texture that will leave you wanting more.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the shrimp and cook for 2-3 minutes per side until pink and cooked through.
In a small bowl, whisk together the miso paste, toor dal, lemon juice, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Pour the miso mixture over the shrimp and stir to combine.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 2 minutes until the sauce has thickened.
Serve the shrimp hot, garnished with chopped parsley or cilantro if desired.
Let the dish rest for a few minutes before serving to allow the sauce to set.
Serve with crusty bread or over rice to soak up the sauce.
